name: System Health Check

syntax: $cpu = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property LoadPercentage -Average).Average; $memory = Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem; $memUsed = [math]::Round((($memory.TotalVisibleMemorySize - $memory.FreePhysicalMemory) / $memory.TotalVisibleMemorySize) * 100, 2); $disks = Get-WmiObject Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter 'DriveType=3' | Select-Object DeviceID, @{Name='FreeSpace(GB)';Expression={[math]::Round($_.FreeSpace/1GB,2)}}, @{Name='Size(GB)';Expression={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, @{Name='UsedPercent';Expression={[math]::Round((($_.Size-$_.FreeSpace)/$_.Size)*100,2)}}; [PSCustomObject]@{CPUUsage="$cpu%"; MemoryUsage="$memUsed%"; Disks=$disks}

name: Get WiFi Passwords
description: Retrieves saved WiFi passwords from the system
syntax: netsh wlan show profiles | Select-String ':(.+)$' | ForEach-Object {$_.Matches.Groups[1].Value.Trim()} | ForEach-Object { $password = (netsh wlan show profile name="$_" key=clear) | Select-String 'Key Content\W+:(.+)$' | ForEach-Object {$_.Matches.Groups[1].Value.Trim()}; [PSCustomObject]@{Profile=$_; Password=$password} }

examples.resolved_command: netsh wlan show profiles | Select-String ':(.+)$' | ForEach-Object {$_.Matches.Groups[1].Value.Trim()} | ForEach-Object { $password = (netsh wlan show profile name="$_" key=clear) | Select-String 'Key Content\W+:(.+)$' | ForEach-Object {$_.Matches.Groups[1].Value.Trim()}; [PSCustomObject]@{Profile=$_; Password=$password} }

name: Network Diagnostics

name: Backup User Profile
description: Backs up important user profile folders to specified location
syntax: $folders = @('Desktop', 'Documents', 'Downloads', 'Pictures'); $destination = {backup_path}; foreach ($folder in $folders) {{ $source = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE $folder; if (Test-Path $source) {{ $dest = Join-Path $destination $folder; Copy-Item -Path $source -Destination $dest -Recurse -Force }} }}

variables.name: backup_path
variables.description: Backup path value

examples.resolved_command: $folders = @('Desktop', 'Documents', 'Downloads', 'Pictures'); $destination = <backup_path>; foreach ($folder in $folders) { $source = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE $folder; if (Test-Path $source) { $dest = Join-Path $destination $folder; Copy-Item -Path $source -Destination $dest -Recurse -Force } }
